title: ID0420945-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R4 170001763 ERK] Error Message
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
Charging point 4 is unavailable and cannot be resolved even by rebooting (remotely).
The error history frequently displays the status "unavailable" and "Faulty."
Software Version: v6.0.3-0-g215cb74+APN (PRODUCTION)
OCPP Backend Connection: Yes
